response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux) SELECT fundflux, cnt AS qc_count, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS fraction_of_total, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) FROM c) AS ratio_to_average FROM c
